$comment: ELSTER MCP Server - Beispielkonfiguration. Nach config.json kopieren (gitignored). Das Zertifikats-Passwort gehört NICHT hierher, sondern in ELSTER_PASSWORD_FILE (chmod 600), den OS-Keyring (python -m elster_mcp store-secret cert-password) oder notfalls ELSTER_PASSWORD. Umgebungsvariablen haben Vorrang.

taxpayer.$taxNumberComment: Steuernummer in the format your Finanzamt issued it (with or without slashes).
taxpayer.$stateCodeComment: ELSTER state code of your Finanzamt (first digits of the 13-digit tax number): BW 28, BY 9, BE 11, BB 30, HB 24, HH 22, HE 26, MV 40, NI 23, NW 5, RP 27, SL 10, SN 32, ST 31, SH 21, TH 41 (letter codes like 'HE' work too). Enter taxNumber as printed on your tax notice or in 13-digit form; the XML snapshot always uses the 13-digit form.

security.$comment: allowSubmit=false: elster_ustva_confirm verweigert jede Übermittlung. requireElicitation=true: Freigabe nur, wenn der MCP-Client den Menschen direkt fragen kann.

http.$comment: Nur für --transport http. Token über ELSTER_MCP_TOKEN_FILE setzen.

ustva.$comment: Reverse-Charge supplier patterns (§13b UStG). region=EU -> KZ 46/47, region=NON_EU -> KZ 73/74. Vorsteuer always KZ 67. Patterns are case-insensitive JS regexes matched against contactName / description.
